title.zh: SmartLingo Flash／Max／Guru 学习入口重组
title.en: SmartLingo Flash, Max and Guru learning-entry redesign

purpose.zh: 让手机用户先选择免费休闲学习或认真学习，再从简洁的语言页进入练习、AI 导师和现有直播教室。
purpose.en: Let phone learners choose casual free practice or focused Max learning, then enter practice, AI tutoring and existing live rooms from compact language hubs.

zh: 首页改为 Flash、Max 与 Guru 三个清晰入口，保留十分钟新手视频链接；顶部菜单同步更新。
Flash 可匿名选择语言并玩免费活动；Max 登录后只触发一次七天试用，现有付费会员不会误标为试用。
用户面板分别显示 Max 与 Flash 语言，以及 Max 到期日和续订入口；语言页集中展示生活口语、游戏、智慧卡、测评、角色导师与既有教室入口。
Guru 保持干净聊天界面，并以列表图标打开常见问题。
en: Replace the homepage with clear Flash, Max and Guru entries, retain the ten-minute tour link, and update the primary navigation.
Let visitors choose Flash languages anonymously; start the existing one-time seven-day trial on signed-in Max entry without mislabeling paid access as a trial.
Separate Max and Flash languages on the dashboard, show Max expiry and extension, and collect speaking, games, SmartCards, placement, role tutor and existing room links in each language hub.
Keep Guru as a clean chat and open suggested questions from a list icon.

zh: 首页、导航、Flash／Max 入口、用户面板、语言页、Guru 聊天；不改变支付价格或数据库结构。
en: Home, navigation, Flash/Max entry, dashboard, language hubs and Guru chat; no price or database-schema changes.

zh: 复用现有学习计划、一次性 Max 试用、课程教室和角色导师；Flash 语言保存在当前浏览器，Max 语言沿用现有会员学习计划。
en: Reuse existing learning plans, one-time Max trials, course rooms and the role tutor; Flash language choices remain in the current browser while Max choices use existing member learning plans.

zh: TypeScript、零警告 lint、构建与敏感信息扫描通过；全量自动测试及新增匿名 Flash／Max 权限测试通过；WebKit 与生产浏览器在部署时核验。
en: TypeScript, zero-warning lint, build and sensitive-data scan passed; full automated suite and new anonymous Flash/Max access tests passed; WebKit and production browser are verified during release.

zh: Flash 的匿名语言选择仅保存在当前浏览器；只有已加入语言班的会员才能进入对应教室。未产生真实付款或开启直播。
en: Anonymous Flash choices are device-local; only members joined to a language class can enter its room. No real payment or live broadcast was initiated.

zh: 沿用 SmartLingo 十二种界面语言、既有课程数据与教室权限；新入口在小屏上收敛为单列。
en: Preserve SmartLingo's twelve interface languages, existing course data and room permissions; stack the new entries into one column on phones.

rollback.zh: 无需数据回退；若需撤销界面重组，重新部署上一成功提交即可，已有试用和学习计划记录保持原状。
rollback.en: No data rollback is required; redeploy the previous successful commit to revert the UI while existing trials and learning plans remain intact.
